svg.title: Logo identity and applications
svg.desc: STFE 2027 brand identity. Fonts: Rajdhani and Manrope (Google Fonts, SIL OFL) must be installed for correct text rendering. The STFE 2027 logo is the approved raster artwork embedded unaltered.

text.tspan: Faceted STFE letterforms in blue, violet and magenta.
The edition year carries the STFE globe — local event,
Warm-to-cool ribbons wrap the mark and signal
x = height of the globe. Keep this space free of text and graphics.
Below 120 px use the globe mark alone.
The approved logo is used as supplied: never recoloured, outlined, stretched or placed directly on colour.
